description: NoiseModelling is the UMRAE and Lab-STICC teams' Java software for environmental noise simulation. It implements CNOSSOS-EU road and railway emissions and propagation with terrain, ground absorption, building reflections and diffraction. Inputs include traffic flows, speeds, pavement, terrain, buildings and receiver locations; outputs include noise maps, time-dependent indicators and population-exposure summaries. Coverage ranges from local sites to national networks, with user-defined receivers and time intervals. Code and documentation are free under GPL-3.0. Java, Groovy, command-line and WPS interfaces are documented, alongside an H2GIS database. A limitation is that PostGIS support remains in progress, and exposure accuracy depends on the traffic and geometry inputs. The software can compare transport mitigation scenarios or process trajectories from traffic simulators. OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap) is a supported source of roads and buildings. No spatial dataset or installer was downloaded.
